intent_triggers: population genetics goal without usable input files
ambiguous request for PCA, ADMIXTURE, FST, ROH, or selection without declared inputs

required_any: PLINK BED/BIM/FAM, PED/MAP, or PGEN/PVAR/PSAM path/name inventory plus metadata
BAM/CRAM or genotype-likelihood path/name inventory plus sequencing context
existing PCA, ADMIXTURE, PLINK summary, FST, ROH, or selection result files
declared_input_requirements.raw_genomic_files: inventory-only; raw genomic contents are not parsed

missing_input_rules: If no usable input signal is declared, return missing input notes and recommended next inputs only.
If only a broad goal is present, ask for inventory-only file paths/names before workflow planning.
Do not generate executable commands; command previews are dry-run only explanatory placeholders.
preflight_checks: Confirm raw genomic files remain inventory-only.
Require human expert review before any scientific decision.

dry_run_steps.title: Collect declared input inventory
dry_run_steps.description: List missing VCF, PLINK, BAM/CRAM, genotype-likelihood, metadata, or existing-result inputs without parsing raw genomic contents.

dry_run_steps.title: Explain blocked planning
dry_run_steps.description: Block population-genetics workflow claims until at least one usable input signal is declared.

command_preview_templates.description: Dry-run only placeholder explaining that no command is appropriate before inputs are declared.
command_preview_templates.preview: # DRY-RUN ONLY: no genomics command preview is generated until concrete input inventory is provided.

allowed_with_review: The declared inputs are insufficient for population-genetics workflow planning.
soften: Convert confident scientific interpretations into requests for missing inputs.
block: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components

blocked_interpretations: literal ancestry interpretation from ADMIXTURE components
scientific_validity_notes: No population-genetics conclusion is valid without declared inputs and human expert review.
external_llm_called=false by default; external_tools_executed=false; raw genomic files are inventory-only.
human_review_checklist: Human expert review required: confirm that the research goal is appropriate and non-clinical.
Confirm that no clinical diagnosis or treatment recommendation is requested.
Confirm that any caste/community/religion, consumer ancestry, genetic purity/superiority, PCA cluster identity, ADMIXTURE ancestry, unsupported selection, or unsupported endogamy claim is blocked.
